summary.title: Engineering Managers
summary.one_liner: The public landing page for the Engineering Managers Slack community, which sets out who may join, its code of conduct, and how to request an invite.
keywords: how to join engineering managers slack
takeaways: Who the Engineering Managers Slack group is for: current engineering managers, team leads, and others managing people in technology
The group operates under the Chatham House Rule, so information can be reused but commenters must not be identified
Rules on harassment, unsolicited advice, advertising, and recruiting posts in the community
Invites are requested through a Google Form; default channels are #general and #intros
summary.summary: This is the public landing page for the Engineering Managers Slack group, a confidential space for people new to the engineering manager role. It explains eligibility, then sets out the full community code of conduct: Chatham House Rule, a harassment definition and reporting process, consequences, a no-advertising policy, and rules for sharing job postings. It ends with how to request an invite via a Google Form, a short overview of Slack channels, and credits. The page is a policy and onboarding document rather than technical content.
